subject: Marketplace listing: brand language + regional support window mapping
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Liu <dana.liu@stratushealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing: brand language + regional support window mapping

Team — looping you all in for a quick preflight on the Stratus Health listing we plan to push to AWS/Azure/GCP next month. High-level asks below; see attached matrix and draft listing copy for the current language.

Key concerns I want us to resolve before submission:
- Brand/claims: they have "enterprise-grade" and a few product feature callouts (HIPAA-ready, near-zero latency). Need legal + product sign-off or safer phrasing.
- Trademark terms: Stratus is using a partner trademark in a header — need brand clearance from our legal team before listing.
- Support SLA windows: Stratus is requesting a "24/7 global response" footnote, but their support actually varies by region (EU business hours + emergency on-call). We need an explicit mapping table in the listing so marketplace ops and buyers see accurate commitments.
- Evidence: AWS will ask for a support routing diagram and incident playbook; add links to evidence in the Drive.

Desired outcomes for this thread:
1) Agree final copy edits for branding/claims (suggest alternatives).
2) Confirm SLA mapping we can include (or a footnote path for exceptions).
3) If anything needs legal escalation, call it out and I'll loop Legal.

Attachments: marketplace_claims_matrix.xlsx (xlsx), draft_listing_copy.md (md)

Thanks — can we get initial responses by EOD? I'll schedule a 30m sync if we need it.

—Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0193

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@stratushealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: brand language + regional support window mapping

Marissa — quick notes: 
- "Enterprise-grade" is sticky. Recommend we default to "production-ready" or "designed for enterprise deployments" which is less of a legal trigger and still communicates robustness.
- For HIPAA-related language: nothing should say "HIPAA-compliant" unless Stratus provides written attestation/certificates. Suggest: "supports HIPAA workflows with customer-managed controls".
- SLA: if Stratus cannot commit 24/7 remediation, add a clear matrix: 
  * US: 24/7 phone + 4hr P1 response
  * EU: 09:00–18:00 CET primary; on-call emergency outside hours (response within 8 hours)
  * APAC: 10:00–19:00 local plus ticketed support outside hours
  I added a tentative mapping row in regional_sla_map.csv.

If Legal is going to review trademarks/claims, let's prep a short evidence bundle (SOC2, incident runbook, support roster). I can ask Solutions to assemble.

Happy to take point on the AWS evidence request with Partner Ops.

—Ben Carter
Director, Strategic GTM | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@stratushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: brand language + regional support window mapping

Thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from Stratus: 
- They can accept "production-ready" but want to retain a short phrase about "optimized for health data workloads" — legal wanted that preserved. We can compromise on wording if Redwood legal approves.
- On support: Stratus insists EU customers get faster escalation via a partner support line (different SLA). They asked if we can include a footnote with partner contact routing rather than listing multiple SLAs in the top-level copy.
- Attachments: I'll push an updated contact matrix with regional phone numbers to the Drive by EOD.

Dana Liu
Head of Partnerships | Stratus Health
dana.liu@stratushealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Liu <dana.liu@stratushealth.com>, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: 2028-06-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: brand language + regional support window mapping

Folks — thanks for the notes. I updated marketplace_claims_matrix.xlsx with proposed copy swaps and flagged three rows that need Legal sign-off (trademark use, "HIPAA-ready", and the phrase "optimized for health data workloads"). Please review the spreadsheet.

Action items I captured below (from thread):
- Ben: coordinate Solutions to collect SOC2 evidence + runbook. Put artifacts into the Drive folder. (owner: ben_carter / due: 2028-06-24)
- Laura: start a Legal intake ticket for trademark/claim clearance and include the highlighted rows. (owner: laura_bennett / due: 2028-06-23)
- Logan: confirm AWS Partner Ops contact and whether we can include a footnote for partner-specific routing vs top-level SLA matrix. (owner: logan_wright / due: 2028-06-23)
- Dana: please upload the regional contact matrix you mentioned and confirm whether Stratus can accept the proposed EU wording. (owner: Dana Liu / due: 2028-06-22)

Quote for context — Ben wrote earlier:
> "If Stratus cannot commit 24/7 remediation, add a clear matrix... I added a tentative mapping row in regional_sla_map.csv."

Attachments: regional_sla_map.csv (csv)

If we don't have Legal clearance by the 24th I won't submit the listing. Please flag any blockers. I'll open a 30-minute preflight sync for Fri 6/24 10:00 PT if needed.

—Marissa

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@stratushealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: brand language + regional support window mapping

Acknowledged — I've opened Legal intake ticket LEG-2028-114 (link in Drive). I've attached the intake summary and flagged the trademark and HIPAA phrasing for expedited review. Legal asked for the following to be uploaded to the ticket: SOC2 Type II report, incident runbook, and the partner trademark authorization.

I'll monitor and update the ticket; if Legal needs us to remove language immediately we'll revert to the safer copy: "designed for customers in regulated industries".

I'll be on the 6/24 10:00 PT sync if you run it.

—Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
